A   G   E   N   D   A
To access online viewing of board meetings:
http://www.tahoecitypud.com/general/agenda.shtml
Instructions for Public Participation:
Members of the public may attend the Zoom teleconference by telephone, computer or mobile device. To participate via Zoom join the meeting from the link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86013028520 Meeting ID: 860 1302 8520 Telephone: (669) 900-6833
Members of the public will be admitted into the meeting as an attendee, with audio and video controls disabled. If you wish to make a public comment use the ‘Raise Hand’ feature in Zoom or *9 on your telephone. You will be called upon and unmuted when it is your turn to provide comment. Comments must be 3 minutes or less and limited to one comment per item.

Tahoe City, California 96145

C.
PUBLIC COMMENT
Any person may address the Board of Directors for 3 minutes, and at the discretion of the Board President, may be extended to 5 minutes on any subject within the jurisdiction of Tahoe City Public Utility District that does not appear elsewhere on the agenda. The Board will confer and decide upon one of the following but otherwise will not take any action: 1) Agree to continue discussion at another meeting by placing the subject on a future agenda; 2) Individual Board members may ask questions of staff; or 3) End public comment on subject.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All items listed under the consent calendar-motions are considered to be routine and/or have been reviewed by committee, and will be approved by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a board member or staff person requests a specific item be removed from the consent calendar for separate consideration. Any item removed will be considered after the motion and vote to approve the remainder of consent calendar-motions.

ADJOURNMENT
Public participation is encouraged. Agenda copies and a complete agenda packet are located on the Public Information table in the meeting room. The meeting location is accessible to people with disabilities. The District will provide appropriate auxiliary aids or services when necessary to ensure effective communications with members of the public who have hearing, sight, or speech impairments, unless to do so would result in a fundamental alteration of its programs or an undue administrative or financial burden. To request an accommodation or an auxiliary aid or service, please contact the District Clerk at (530) 580-6052, or by email at tviehmann@tcpud.org at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.
Any public record relating to an open session agenda item distributed prior to the meeting is available for public inspection at the District Offices located at 221 Fairway Drive during normal business hours, or can be viewed on the District website www.tahoecitypud.com.

Terri Viehmann
